attributes.title: Wires
attributes.lede: Hover a mark. The comment still has hold.

lesson.why: A tether derives the wire from endpoint geometry during motion. Stable thread identity lets connected paths retarget instead of tearing down and fading in each time a node moves.
lesson.experiment: Move a connected node again before it lands. Track the endpoint and the bend of each wire through the interruption.
lesson.pitfall: Tweening a separately guessed SVG path cannot reliably match an interrupted spring-driven endpoint.
lesson.combine: Combine with escort when a badge, shadow and connecting line must follow the same moving item.
